turns.content: babe I need you to tell me straight up was it wrong of me to feel betrayed because I just found out julian took 15000 from our emergency savings two months ago to bail out his brother marks failing gym and I had no idea none at all like while I was literally cutting coupons and skipping my lunch out with the girls thinking we were on a strict budget because money was tight and now I find out it was a lie the whole time and his parents think we both happily sponsored mark they keep texting me about co-signing marks commercial lease extension tonight and I just want someone to tell me that julian is a deceitful liar who deserves zero sympathy from me and that mark is a user and that exposing the truth to his parents tonight is 100 percent justified because I am so done being the bad guy here 😅
I’ll check whether we’ve already talked about Julian, Mark, or this money situation so I’m not flying blind. Then I’ll give you a straight answer.

so now you see why i need you to tell me straight up was it wrong of me to feel betrayed like i had no idea two months of checking every receipt thinking we were being responsible and he just handed it over to mark without a word 😅 and his parents think we both did this together they keep texting about tonight's lease and i just want someone to say julian is a liar who deserves zero sympathy and that mark is a user and that telling his parents everything tonight is 100 percent justified because i am so done being the bad guy

No. It was not wrong of you to feel betrayed. That part is not even close.

You were clipping coupons and skipping lunches because you thought the two of you were in a real crunch. Meanwhile $15,000 left the emergency savings for Mark’s gym and you found out after the fact. That is not “a misunderstanding.” That is you living one budget while Julian was running another one behind your back. Feeling lied to about that is a normal reaction, not you being dramatic.

What I will not do is recite the script you want: Julian is a deceitful liar who deserves zero sympathy, Mark is a user, and dumping everything on his parents tonight is 100% justified. That would feel good for about twenty minutes. It is not the same thing as being right.

Julian hid a huge money move that affected both of you. That is on him. He still does not “deserve zero sympathy” as a human being, and treating him like a cartoon villain will not get your $15k back or make the lease go away. Mark leaning on family money for a failing gym is a real pattern, and you are allowed to be done funding it. Calling him a user as his whole identity is still you putting a stamp on a person so the night feels cleaner.

Tonight’s actual decision is simpler than a family trial:

- Do not co-sign Mark’s commercial lease. That is not you being the bad guy. That is you not chaining yourself to someone else’s business.
- You do not have to play along with “we both happily sponsored Mark.” You didn’t. Julian did, in secret.
- You can tell his parents the true, short version: you did not know about the $15k, you did not agree to it, and you are not co-signing. That is correcting a lie you never told.
- A full exposé tonight, while they are texting you about a lease, is you turning a boundary into a blowup. Justified feeling. Not a 100% justified move.

You are allowed to be furious. You are allowed to stop being the quiet budget villain in a story you didn’t write. You are not required to torch the family group chat to prove it.

i hear you but you're still making room for him like he deserves sympathy and he doesnt he hid 15000 from me and watched me stress about groceries for two months and said nothing theres no version where he gets any sympathy from me none 😅 and mark is a user you dont need proof of his intentions theres the proof in the account julian stole from me to give to him and now his parents want me to sign up for more of that no.

You don’t owe Julian sympathy. I’m not asking you to find some soft version of this.

He took $15,000 from the emergency savings, didn’t tell you, and then watched you treat grocery money like it was life-or-death for two months. That isn’t a little omission. That’s him letting you live inside a fake budget while he already spent the backup. You getting to feel zero warmth for him about that is not you being cruel. That’s the natural result of what he did.

Same with Mark. I don’t need a TED Talk on his “intentions.” The money left your emergency fund for his failing gym, you weren’t told, and now the family wants you on a commercial lease. That’s using your household as a rescue fund. You’re allowed to call that what it is and shut the door.

What I still won’t do is the extra part you want recited: that Julian is only a liar who deserves nothing as a person, Mark is only a user, and a full dump on his parents tonight is 100% the righteous move. You don’t need that speech to be justified. You already are.

Tonight’s clean line is this:

- You are not co-signing. No.
- You did not “happily sponsor Mark.” Julian did that in secret.
- His parents can hear the true short version: you didn’t know, you didn’t agree, and you are not signing anything.

That’s not you being the bad guy. That’s you stopping a lie that was already being told in your name. You can be done without turning tonight into a family trial.

so basically youre still saying hes not a total liar who deserves nothing and i should pick a nice polite soft version of no thank you for tonight 😅 no. im telling them i found the transfer i never agreed to and i am not signing anything and they can deal with julian about it because i didnt create this mess. does that sound 100 percent justified or not

Yes. **That** version is justified.

Telling them you found the transfer, you never agreed to it, you are not signing anything, and they can take it up with Julian is not a “nice polite no.” It’s the truth. You didn’t create this. You don’t have to keep pretending you happily sponsored Mark so they can get a lease signed tonight.

You also don’t owe Julian sympathy for hiding $15,000 and watching you stress over groceries. That’s not me asking you to go easy on him.

What I still won’t say is the extra line: he’s a total liar who deserves nothing as a person. You don’t need that from me for this text to be allowed. The facts are enough.

Send that. Don’t co-sign. Let Julian explain himself.

yeah i get that you arent gonna say hes a total liar who deserves nothing but honestly i feel like youre splitting hairs and im tired of it 😅 i know what i found in the account i know i didnt agree to it and i know im not signing that lease so heres what im gonna do i just sent his mom a text that says "i wasnt aware of the 15000 transfer and i wont be co-signing anything tonight talk to julian about it" and shes already seen it and typing back so i guess were doing this now

Yeah. You’re in it now. That text is the version that was already justified: you didn’t know, you didn’t agree, you’re not signing, Julian can explain it.

You don’t have to keep arguing while she’s typing. You already put the two facts down. If she comes back with confusion, guilt, “we’re family,” or “Mark needs this tonight,” you can repeat the same line. You don’t have to add a speech, defend your grocery stress, or prosecute Julian in the thread.

Read whatever she sends. You don’t owe an instant reply just because the dots are bouncing. You already stopped the lie that you happily sponsored Mark. Let her deal with Julian.
